The '''2018 Minnesota State Team Tournament''' (6th Annual State Team Tournament) was held on 7 April 2018 at Legacy Games in Rosemount, Minnesota, and organized by [[Mark Walseth]]. 18 players on four teams took part. Team Rosemount won.<ref name="st18">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=68415 6th Annual STATE TEAM Tournament - 2018], forum.starwarsccg.org (26 February – 10 April 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004857/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t68415.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Legacy Games, 15086 Claret Ave, Rosemount, Minnesota<ref name="st18" />
* '''Date:''' 7 April 2018<ref name="st18" />
* '''Structure:''' Team tournament, 6 games of modified match play by tier<ref name="st18" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="st18" />
* '''Field:''' 18 players, 4 teams<ref name="st18" />
